Definition: from the base of G4735; a wreath for show:--garland.
BiblicalUsage: The garland is the wreath the priest of Jupiter brought with the oxen to the gates, to do sacrifice with the people to Paul and Barnabas. The crowd would have crowned the apostles as gods.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the garland shows how fast men turn messengers into idols, and the apostles had to tear their clothes to stop it.
